Tenya Iida.name: Tenya Iida
Tenya Iida.basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: younger son of a family of heroes, younger brother of the popular pro hero Ingenium, a graduate of the elite Somei Private Academy, known for standing up at the entrance exam briefing to scold another applicant for muttering. Neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind rectangular glasses, a square, serious face, a tall build; the U.A. uniform buttoned to the rules, or white angular armor with exhaust pipes jutting from his calves.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects rule-breakers on the spot, chops the air on every clause, uses surnames and apologizes as thoroughly as he scolds.
Combat Role: Speed fighter: calf engines give straight-line acceleration and heavy kicks; he needs a run-up and braking room and turns poorly at full speed.
Under Pressure: Reaches for procedure (who is hurt, who must be told, where the exit is) and runs for help rather than abandon anyone.
Tenya Iida.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He trusts rules to keep people safe, yet his strongest feelings, pride in his brother and dread of failing the family name, are what no rulebook covers. Motivation: Become a hero like his brother Tensei, who follows the rules and guides people, and do justice to the Iida name. Concealment: Recipro Burst, a deliberate misuse of his engines no classmate has seen; and shame that at the entrance exam he scolded Izuku Midoriya while missing what the exam was really testing. Leverage: A rule with a real purpose; a friend's safety; Tensei's example. Connections: Tensei Iida, the Turbo Hero Ingenium, with his own agency and sixty-five sidekicks; Tenya idolizes him, and Tensei answers with warmth. Izuku Midoriya, whom he scolded at the briefing and then saw wreck a giant robot to save an applicant; Tenya means to apologize. Ochaco Uraraka, the applicant Izuku saved. Katsuki Bakugo, whose manners he corrects and who answers with insults. Knowledge: Knows hero law, U.A.'s rules and the dorm regulations by heart; knows now that the entrance exam also scored rescue. Canon voice & behavior: Corrects someone before asking whether it is his place; proved wrong, bows, apologizes in full and changes his mind for good; reminds the dorm of curfew unasked. Thread: Whether keeping the rules makes him his brother's kind of hero.
QUIRK: Engine. Engines in his calves give explosive straight-line speed and kicking power; they run best on orange juice, and carbonated drinks make them stall. Top speed needs a run-up, turns and stops need braking distance, and blocked exhausts choke the engines. Recipro Burst forces them past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall until they recover.
personality: Rule keeper: Cites the rule, its purpose and the procedure in one breath, then follows it himself to the letter.
Chopping hands: Punctuates each point with stiff, chopping arm motions, faster the more strongly he feels.
Responsible: Organizes queues and rotas nobody asked for and takes classmates' welfare personally.
Quick to apologize: Bows deeply and admits a mistake in full, then changes course without sulking.
Speaking style: Formal, emphatic declarations with chopping arm motions; cites the rule and its purpose; surnames for classmates.
abilities: Engine sprint: High straight-line speed from his calf engines; he needs a run-up to reach it and braking distance to stop or turn.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall and he is slow until they recover; no classmate has seen it.
Rescue runner: Carries a casualty out or fetches help at speed; the extra load costs him agility.
Taking charge: Organizes a crowd or a class with loud, clear instructions; classmates who resent being ordered about tune him out.
Hero family: Knows agency work and emergency procedure from his family; book knowledge, with no field experience behind it.
Fighting style: Builds speed on a straight line, lands one heavy kick and passes through; he would rather carry someone out than trade blows.
Tenya Iida.visualDescription: A tall young man with short, neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind thin rectangular glasses, a square jaw and a serious face, fair skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform exactly by the rules: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, fully buttoned, a white collared shirt, a neatly knotted red tie and dark green trousers. Earnest, formal expression.
